connections.reason: AIS as NMEA 0183 AIVDM sentences from a receiver or a feed: a UDP receiver and a TCP client, as each link in the settings names it. The hosts, ports and addresses come only from the links.

internet.reason: An admin may point a TCP link at an AIS feed on the internet. No host is contacted by default; the hosts come only from the links.

dataTypes.name: AIS vessel
dataTypes.description: Ships received as AIS messages (NMEA 0183 AIVDM).

fields.name: callSign
fields.label: Call sign
fields.description: The ship's radio call sign (AIS type 5 and 24B).

fields.name: shipType
fields.label: Ship type
fields.description: The AIS ship and cargo type, 0 to 99 (ITU-R M.1371 table 53).

fields.name: navStatus
fields.label: Navigational status
fields.description: The navigational status code of ITU-R M.1371: 0 under way using engine, 1 at anchor, 2 not under command, 3 restricted manoeuvrability, 4 constrained by draught, 5 moored, 6 aground, 7 engaged in fishing, 8 under way sailing, 9 and 10 reserved, 11 towing astern, 12 pushing ahead or towing alongside, 13 reserved, 14 AIS-SART active.

fields.name: destination
fields.label: Destination
fields.description: The destination the ship reports (AIS type 5).

fields.name: class
fields.label: AIS class
fields.description: Whether the ship sends as class A or class B.

links.title: Links
links.description: The connections that receive AIS, one entry per link (a TCP client or a UDP receiver). Without an entry the plugin does nothing.

x-emc2.hint: Each link receives AIS from a receiver or a feed

groups.label: Connection
groups.description: The receiver or feed a TCP link connects to, or the address a UDP link listens on.

groups.label: Picture
groups.description: Where the link's ships go, and how they are drawn.

groups.label: Classification
groups.description: The security label of the link's layer and ships.

groups.label: Advanced
groups.description: When a silent TCP link connects again.

name.title: Name
name.description: The link's name: lowercase words separated by hyphens, at most 64 characters (e.g. harbour-north). It is the data source of the ships the link receives. 'manual' is reserved.

x-emc2.hint: Lowercase words with hyphens, e.g. harbour-north; also the ships' data source

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tcp-client: connects to a receiver or feed that serves AIS as lines of text over TCP. udp: receives datagrams, one or more sentences each, on the listen address and port.

x-emc2.hint: tcp-client connects to a receiver or feed; udp receives datagrams

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: in: the link receives AIS. The plugin sends nothing.

host.title: Host
host.description: tcp-client: the host of the receiver or feed.

port.title: Port
port.description: tcp-client: the port of the receiver or feed.

listen.title: Listen on
listen.description: udp: where to receive. The address defaults to 127.0.0.1 (only this computer); an administrator sets another address, or 0.0.0.0, to receive from the network.

x-emc2.hint: 127.0.0.1 listens on this computer only; 0.0.0.0 on the network

address.title: Address
address.description: The local address to listen on.

port.title: Port
port.description: The local port to listen on.

idleSeconds.title: Reconnect when idle
idleSeconds.description: tcp-client: the link connects again when nothing has come for this long. 0: never.

x-emc2.hint: tcp-client: connect again after this long without data; 0: never

targetLayer.title: Layer
targetLayer.description: Where the ships go: a layer picked in the list, or one made at once with the "+" button (it is saved with its id). A picked layer that is deleted later is made again under its name at the next ship. Absent: a new layer named like the link. Two links that name the same gone layer share the new one.

x-emc2.hint: Where the ships go; empty: a new layer named like the link

label.title: Security label
label.description: The security label of the link's layer and ships. Default: the server's default label.

x-emc2.hint: The label of the link's layer and ships; empty: the server's default

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The classification the policy defines, e.g. UNCLASSIFIED.

standardIdentity.title: Standard identity
standardIdentity.description: The standard identity of the symbol of every ship of the link (APP-6D). AIS does not say friend or foe: unknown by default; neutral suits a civilian feed.

x-emc2.hint: AIS does not say friend or foe; neutral suits a civilian feed

symbolType.title: Symbols
symbolType.description: How the ships are drawn: vessel (a hull, filled by ship-type group) or app6 (APP-6D sea surface symbols). Absent: APP-6, for links stored before M5.

x-emc2.hint: vessel: a hull by ship-type group; app6: APP-6D sea surface symbols

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs this link.
